sharedRules.name: Secondary Weapon
sharedRules.description: A Tank may fire its Secondary Weapon at ROF 1 at the same time as its main gun. If they do this, the Secondary Wapon suffers a +1 penalty to hit. Each weapon may fire at a different target.

sharedRules.name: Stabiliser
sharedRules.description: Insted of having a reduced Moving ROF, weapons with Stabiliser suffer a +1 penalty to hit if the shooting Tank Moved in the Moving Step

sharedRules.name: Seek, Strike, and Destroy
sharedRules.description: A Unit with Seek, Strike, and Destroy my attempt a Shoot and Scoot Movement Order after succeeding with a Blitz Move Movment Order earlier in the same turn.

sharedRules.name: MG Transport
sharedRules.description: M1917 HMG or M1919 LMG teams my fire while Mounted as a Passenger in an M3 half-track, using the Optional Passenger MG weapon line.

sharedRules.name: Observer
sharedRules.description: The Unit Leader of a Unit with Observer can spot for any friendly Artilery Unit.

sharedRules.name: Time on Target
sharedRules.description: If an Artillery Unit with Time on Targer ranges in on the first attempt, any Infantry or Gun Teams hit by the Bombardment must re-roll successful Saves.

sharedRules.name: Rangers Lead The Way
sharedRules.description: if Temas in this Unit that start their Moment Step adjacent to a cliff or montain side (or similar terrain feature) pass a Skill Test, they may cross the terrain at Terrain Dash speed.

sharedRules.name: Airborne
sharedRules.description: This Formation may make an Airborne Assault in missions that use the Airborden Assault rules
